app_info.subtitle: Book hotels directly
app_info.description: Hotelzify lets users search hotels in the Hotelzify chain, check room availability and live pricing for specific dates, and complete a direct booking with guest details — all inside ChatGPT. Results are shown as interactive widgets so the user can browse properties, compare rate plans, and confirm a reservation in one conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the Hotelzify search API and returns matching hotels with images and metadata; does not modify any record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from Hotelzify's own search and chain APIs and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs no deletes, overwrites, or irreversible actions; output is a transient list of search results.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calls the Hotelzify availability endpoint to retrieve rooms, rate plans, and prices for the requested dates without creating or updating any reservation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries Hotelzify's private availability service and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns availability and pricing data only; does not delete, overwrite, or commit any booking.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new hotel reservation in Hotelzify by posting the user's guest details and selected rate plan to the bookings API.
justifications.open_world_justification: Submits the booking to Hotelzify's reservation system and triggers a confirmation email to the guest, which is delivered outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a new reservation record; it does not delete, overwrite, or revoke any existing data.

test_cases.expected_output: Returns a list of matching Hotelzify properties in Kerala with name, location, rating, amenities, and images rendered in the hotel search widget.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me beach resorts available through Hotelzify.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns beach-oriented properties from the Hotelzify chain with images and ratings; no booking is created.

test_cases.description: Check availability after picking a hotel from search results.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check room availability at hotel 123 from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12 for 2 adults.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available rooms with rate plans, nightly and total prices, and any discount labels in the room availability widget; no booking is created.

test_cases.description: Check availability with mixed guest composition.
test_cases.user_prompt: Are there family rooms available at hotel 123 for 2 adults and 1 child from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-04?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns rooms that fit the guest mix with pricing for the 3-night stay, or a clear no-availability message if none are returned by the API.

test_cases.description: Complete a direct booking after the user picks a room and provides guest details.
test_cases.user_prompt: Book the Deluxe Room with the Bed & Breakfast rate at hotel 123 from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12 for John Doe, john@example.com, phone +1 5551234567.
test_cases.expected_output: Submits the reservation to Hotelzify and returns a booking ID with the hotel name, room, dates, and a confirmation that an email was sent to the guest.

test_cases.description: Booking is rejected when phone number has no country code.
test_cases.user_prompt: Book the Deluxe Room at hotel 123 from 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12 for John Doe, john@example.com, phone 5551234567.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a clear message asking the user to provide a phone number with a country code; no booking is created.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for flight booking requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a flight from New York to London next Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only handles hotels in the Hotelzify chain, not flights.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for restaurant reservations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reserve a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because dining reservations are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general travel advice without a hotel intent.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's the best time of year to visit Goa?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the user is asking for travel advice, not searching, checking availability, or booking a hotel.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for cancellation or modification of an existing booking.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel my hotel reservation from last week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not expose tools for cancelling or modifying existing reservations.
